chunks: And they certainly sought to seduce him from his guests, so We blinded their eyes; so taste My punishment and My warning.
ai.seo_question: What happened to the people of Lut when they tried to seduce him from his guests?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the specific sin of the people of Lut as the violation of hospitality and public indecency, leading to the divine punishment of blindness before the general destruction. The command 'taste My punishment' emphasizes the immediacy of their retribution, serving as a stern warning for those who reject prophetic guidance. This event is often cited to illustrate the consequences of moral corruption and the loss of spiritual sight.
